name: Six Flags 3.0

name: GHS Greenfield Cricket Ground
description: A highly rated, full-sized cricket playground located in Sector 108, Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana. Situated right behind the Daultabad Gaushala, it is a popular hub for local tournaments, corporate matches, and practice leagues. Pitch & Outfield: It features a well-maintained, clean, and trimmed turf pitch that offers a balanced bounce for both batting and bowling. The outfield is noted by players for being green, lush, and exceptionally quick. The ground provides essential facilities including a reasonably priced in-house canteen serving tasty food, clean washrooms, and supportive ground staff.
